title.narrative: Strengthened capacity of member States to ratify and apply international labour standards and to fulfil their reporting obligations

description.narrative: This CPO supports the Government of Sri Lanka in the ratification of priority International Labour Standards (ILS), including Conventions C188 (Work in Fishing), C155 (Occupational Safety and Health), as well as Conventions C191 and C192. It provides targeted technical assistance to employersâ€™ and workersâ€™ organizations to facilitate the effective implementation of recommendations issued by ILO supervisory bodies, with particular emphasis on fundamental and governance-related Conventions such as C95, C131, and C106. The programme further supports the formulation and adoption of the Decent Work Country Programme (DWCP), ensuring systematic integration of ILS provisions and the recommendations of the Committee of Experts on the Application of Conventions and Recommendations (CEACR). Constituents are strengthened to prepare and submit timely, comprehensive reports under Articles 19 and 22 of the ILO Constitution and to conduct effective tripartite consultations on draft reports, in compliance with the requirements of Convention C144. Implementation is led by the Ministry of Labour in close collaboration with employersâ€™ and workersâ€™ organizations.
